chunks.head: on account of
chunks.note: on account of + 名词 = 由于、因为(比 because of 稍正式)。
chunks.ex_en: The match was cancelled on account of the rain.

chunks.head: in search of
chunks.note: in search of + 目标 = 为寻找某物/某人。
chunks.ex_en: They went out in search of food.

chunks.head: look after
chunks.ex_en: Can you look after my dog this weekend?
chunks.ex_cn: 这个周末你能帮我照看狗吗?

chunks.head: wear off
chunks.note: wear off = (疼痛、新鲜感、药效等)慢慢消失。
chunks.ex_en: The pain will wear off in an hour.
chunks.ex_cn: 一小时后疼痛就会消退。

chunks.head: blow up
chunks.note: blow up = 使爆炸、炸掉;另可指(人)发火,本章为'炸毁'。
chunks.ex_en: The soldiers blew up the bridge.

chunks.head: at length
chunks.note: at length (此处)= 经过很久之后终于;另义'详尽地'。
chunks.ex_en: At length, the bus finally arrived.

chunks.head: put to death
chunks.note: put someone to death = 将某人处死。
chunks.ex_en: The traitor was put to death.

chunks.head: on the other hand
chunks.note: on the other hand = 引出相反或对照的一面。
chunks.ex_en: It's cheap; on the other hand, it isn't very good.
chunks.ex_cn: 它便宜;可另一方面,质量不太好。

chunks.head: take notice of
chunks.note: take notice of = 留意、把…放在心上。
chunks.ex_en: Nobody took notice of the new sign.
chunks.ex_cn: 没人留意到那块新牌子。

chunks.head: put an end to
chunks.note: put an end to something = 使某事终止、制止。
chunks.ex_en: The new rule put an end to the noise.

chunks.head: for fear
chunks.ex_en: She spoke softly for fear of waking the baby.
chunks.ex_cn: 她轻声说话,生怕吵醒宝宝。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(gave it over),故 card-only。give over = 罢手、不再做。
chunks.ex_en: He gave over trying to fix the old clock.
